svg.title: Peaked and flat distributions with which tokens each rule keeps

text.tspan: A fixed K keeps the same count whatever the shape
Filled square = kept by that rule. Bars use the same vertical scale in both panels.
flat: ten logits from 1.0 down to 0.55
Top-k ignores the shape. Top-p and min-p adapt to it.
